title: Microsoft’s AI spending became cloud revenue. Meta’s became a cash-flow hole.
excerpt: Two of the biggest AI spenders reported on the same day. Microsoft’s spending showed up as cloud revenue. Meta’s showed up as a hole in its cash flow. Meta’s revenue rose 28% to $60.8bn, beating forecasts, CNBC reported. But profit fell 14% to $15.8bn, earnings per share missed, and the shares dropped about 5% after […]
content_html:
Two of the biggest AI spenders reported on the same day. Microsoft’s spending showed up as cloud revenue. Meta’s showed up as a hole in its cash flow.

Meta’s revenue rose 28% to $60.8bn, beating forecasts, CNBC reported. But profit fell 14% to $15.8bn, earnings per share missed, and the shares dropped about 5% after hours.

The cash is draining out

The starkest number is free cash flow. It fell to $784m, from $8.55bn a year earlier, a 91% drop, Reuters reported. Meta is now spending faster than the money is coming in.

The reason is the AI build-out. Meta spent about $31bn on capital projects in the quarter alone, and narrowed its full-year guidance upward, to between $130bn and $145bn, it said. Last year it spent $72bn. The bill is roughly doubling.

No cloud to show for it

Here is the difference from its rivals. Microsoft and Alphabet spend on AI and can point to a cloud business that rents the capacity back out. Meta has no such business. Its spending funds its own apps and models, so investors see the cost without an obvious new revenue line.

It is not alone in the squeeze. Alphabet reported its first ever negative free cash flow last week. The financing is also moving off the balance sheet. This week Meta set up a $14bn data-centre venture with BlackRock, which will own 80% of the campus.

Costs and courts

Two one-off costs deepened the profit drop. Meta booked $2.4bn in charges tied to legal proceedings and $1.18bn in severance from its May layoff of about 8,000 staff. Operating margin fell to 31%, from 43% a year earlier.

More legal risk is coming. Meta’s finance chief warned of youth-related trials in the US this year that “may ultimately result in a material loss.” Reality Labs, its headset and glasses unit, lost another $4.6bn, taking its running total past $80bn.

The bet and the payoff

Zuckerberg struck an upbeat note. “AI is accelerating our core business today,” he said, pointing to new products and enterprise opportunities. The ad engine backs him up, with impressions up 14% and prices up 12%.

But the market wanted proof the spending pays off, and did not get it. Revenue is strong, yet profit is shrinking and cash is draining. Same day, same AI bet as Microsoft, opposite verdict.

Published July 29, 2026 - 8:42 pm UTC

content_html_zh:
两家最大的人工智能支出者于同一天发布了报告。 微软的支出表现为云收入。 Meta 的现金流出现了漏洞。

据 CNBC 报道，Meta 的收入增长 28% 至 608 亿美元，超出预期。 但利润下降 14% 至 158 亿美元，每股收益未达预期，盘后股价下跌约 5%。

现金正在耗尽

最明显的数字是自由现金流。 据路透社报道，这一数字从去年同期的 85.5 亿美元降至 7.84 亿美元，降幅达 91%。 Meta 现在的支出速度快于资金的流入速度。

原因是人工智能的扩展。 Meta 仅在本季度就在资本项目上花费了约 310 亿美元，并将全年指引上调至 1300 亿美元至 1450 亿美元之间。 去年它花费了 720 亿美元。 账单大约翻倍。

没有云彩显示

这是与其竞争对手的区别。 微软和 Alphabet 在人工智能上投入了大量资金，可以指向将容量租回的云业务。 Meta没有这样的业务。 它的支出为自己的应用程序和模型提供资金，因此投资者在没有明显的新收入线的情况下看到了成本。

它并不是唯一陷入困境的公司。 Alphabet 上周首次公布了负自由现金流。 融资也正在从资产负债表中移出。 本周，Meta 与贝莱德 (BlackRock) 成立了一家价值 140 亿美元的数据中心合资企业，贝莱德将拥有该园区 80% 的股份。

费用和法院

两项一次性成本加剧了利润下降。 Meta 记入了与法律诉讼相关的 24 亿美元费用，以及 5 月份裁员约 8,000 名员工的 11.8 亿美元遣散费。 营业利润率从去年同期的 43% 降至 31%。

更多的法律风险即将来临。 Meta 的财务主管警告说，美国今年与青少年相关的试验“最终可能会导致物质损失”。 其耳机和眼镜部门 Reality Labs 又损失了 46 亿美元，使其总损失超过 800 亿美元。

赌注和回报

扎克伯格发表了乐观的言论。 “今天，人工智能正在加速我们的核心业务，”他在谈到新产品和企业机遇时说道。 广告引擎为他提供了支持，展示次数增加了 14%，价格上涨了 12%。

但市场想要证明支出得到回报，但没有得到。 收入强劲，但利润却在萎缩，现金也在流失。 同一天，与微软相同的人工智能赌注，却有相反的判决。
